landing.heroSub: Racehorse Club brings the whole club's horse profiles, training plans, health and races into one place — so trainers, vets, grooms and owners all read the same board.

landing.flowsTitle: One club, five jobs on one system

horses.title: Profiles & pedigree
horses.body: Each horse's record, breed, sire and dam, fitness and results — with photo and saddle number.

training.body: Trainers plan in phases, schedule sessions without clashes and record results after each one.

health.body: Vets record exams, treatment plans and injury sites; grooms report incidents with a photo from the stable.

races.title: Races
races.body: The race calendar, entries for eligible horses, and placings and times after each race.

supplies.title: Stable supplies
supplies.body: Feed, medicine, equipment — stock goes down with each meal, and low items go to the manager as purchase requests.

landing.flowSafety: A horse with a serious incident is locked out of training automatically, and only a vet's exam concluding it is fit lifts the lock.
landing.rolesTitle: Five roles, each sees their own work
landing.rolesSub: After you sign up, the club manager assigns your role.

roleDo.MANAGER: Runs the stable, races, supplies and approves new accounts.
roleDo.TRAINER: Writes plans, schedules sessions and follows each horse's progress.
roleDo.VET: Examines, handles incidents and vaccinations, and decides training locks.
roleDo.GROOM: Daily care, feeding records, incident reports and supply requests.
roleDo.OWNER: Follows the health, training and results of the horses they own.

step1.title: Sign up
step1.body: Create an account with email or Google and confirm the code sent to your inbox.
